title: Managed Backup: excluded incidents
content:
For Managed Backup, the following tier basis defines excluded incidents.

## Tier basis

**Excluded outage causes.** Incident cause codes excluded from service credits; string list.

| Contract tier | Excluded outage causes |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB | Customer change; Scheduled maintenance; Upstream customer |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 10 TB | Customer change; Scheduled maintenance; Upstream customer |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 25 TB | Customer change; Scheduled maintenance; Upstream customer |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 50 TB | Customer change; Scheduled maintenance; Upstream customer |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 100 TB | Customer change; Scheduled maintenance; Upstream customer |
| Northbridge Managed Backup 250 TB | Customer change; Scheduled maintenance; Upstream customer |

## Tier lookup

For the Northbridge Managed Backup 5 TB tier, excluded outage causes is Customer change; Scheduled maintenance; Upstream customer.

## Hypothetical comparison

In a hypothetical switch between any of the listed tiers, excluded outage causes stays the same.
